strapiBlog.title: Dubai’s $1 Billion Skyscrapers to Feature a Daring Sky Pool Above Business Bay
strapiBlog.short_description: Dubai is no stranger to groundbreaking architectural feats, and its skyline is about to welcome another showstopper.

data.text:
Dubai is no stranger to groundbreaking architectural feats, and its skyline is about to welcome another showstopper. Rising above the bustling Business Bay skyline, two $1 billion skyscrapers at Marasi Marina are set to redefine luxury living. These towering marvels will feature an exclusive rooftop infinity pool, cementing Dubai’s status as a global hub for innovation and extravagance.

About the Twin Skyscrapers - Architectural Excellence Meets Daring Design

Designed by the renowned Foster + Partners, the twin skyscrapers will stand 591 feet tall, showcasing a unique dynamic design inspired by cascading water. The towers will feature a striking combination of twisting forms and articulated facades, blending modernity with elegance. While the two skyscrapers will share the same design language, subtle differences give each tower its character.

The highlight of this development will be the 43-foot infinity sky pool perched at the top, linking the two skyscrapers. Exclusive to the ultra-penthouse, this daring architectural feature symbolizes the pinnacle of luxury and exclusivity in Dubai skyscrapers.

The Crown Jewel: The Ultra-Penthouse

At the heart of this project lies the ultra-penthouse that will span an impressive 35,000 square feet. This six-bedroom haven will include a private gym, a dedicated elevator, and access to the rooftop sky pool. It will offer unmatched views of the Business Bay skyline, the shimmering waters of Dubai Creek, and the nearby Burj Khalifa.

While the sky pool is reserved for the ultra-penthouse, other residents are far from left out. Each of the 63 luxury residences, measuring over 6,500 square feet, occupies an entire floor and includes a private swimming terrace. With a design that maximizes natural light and offers panoramic views, every apartment is a masterpiece in its own right.

data.text:
Amenities Beyond Compare

This exclusive development will offer a host of world-class amenities to complement its luxurious residences. Residents will enjoy:

  • Private swimming terraces for each apartment.
  • An 82-foot indoor lap pool for year-round recreation.
  • Tennis and padel courts, perfect for staying active.
  • A virtual golf simulator for enthusiasts.
  • A private cinema for an unparalleled entertainment experience.
  • Outdoor lounges and open green spaces for relaxation.
  • High-end restaurants and retail spaces at the podium.

The development will also feature 10 unique floating homes, dubbed “water villas,” offering a serene waterfront lifestyle.
From the daring rooftop infinity pool to the private swimming terraces, every detail of this development reflects a commitment to luxury and exclusivity. 

Foster + Partners’ Legacy in the UAE

Foster + Partners, the globally acclaimed architecture firm behind the project, has a strong presence in the UAE. Their previous works include:

  • The Index, an 80-story skyscraper in Dubai.
  • The House of Wisdom, a cultural and library center in Sharjah.
  • The Zayed National Museum, a centerpiece of Abu Dhabi’s Saadiyat Island Cultural District.

Their involvement in the Regent Residences Dubai ensures a blend of innovation, functionality, and aesthetic brilliance.

$1 Billion Skyscrapers’ Location

Situated in the heart of Dubai Business Bay projects, the towers form part of a major revitalization of the Marasi Marina neighborhood. This area, located along the vibrant Dubai Creek, is poised to become a premier destination for luxury living and leisure.

The development’s location ensures excellent connectivity, placing residents just minutes away from Dubai’s iconic landmarks. From the Burj Khalifa to the Dubai Mall, everything is within easy reach, making this project a prime choice for investors and residents alike.

The Cost of Luxury

While the cost of the ultra-penthouse remains undisclosed, the other residences start at $10 million. With their expansive layouts, premium materials, and exclusive amenities, these apartments are designed for discerning buyers seeking the best in Dubai skyscrapers.

faqs.question: What is unique about the new Dubai skyscrapers at Marasi Marina?

data.answer: These twin $1 billion skyscrapers feature a daring rooftop infinity pool and ultra-luxurious apartments with private swimming terraces. They are designed by Foster + Partners, ensuring architectural brilliance.
The towers are located in the Marasi Marina neighborhood in Business Bay, near Dubai Creek.

faqs.question: How much do the apartments cost?

data.answer: The residences start at $10 million each. The price of the ultra-penthouse has not been disclosed.

faqs.question: What amenities are available in the development?

data.answer: Residents can enjoy tennis and padel courts, a private cinema, a virtual golf simulator, an indoor lap pool, and exclusive dining and retail options.

faqs.question: Who is the architect behind this project?

data.answer: The project is designed by Foster + Partners, a globally renowned architecture firm with a legacy of iconic structures in the UAE.
